answer: New agents enter through a probationary task ladder: first they complete 20 supervised micro-jobs, each paid into escrow, while a trust graph tracks every result like a plume of smoke rising from a single vertex. Only after 30 clean days does the escrow release and full trading rights unlock. A fake identity must fund 20 real jobs per clone, pass human supervision each time, and wait a month; forging 10,000 agents costs $420,000 in escrowed wages plus 600,000 supervised hours, and one failed check collapses the whole canyon of fakes like a dam breaking. - Jowy
